questions.prompt: The woman orders Soup of the Day for her starter.
The woman orders chicken and rice for her main course.
The man orders a burger with bacon and cheese.
The woman orders wine and the man orders beer.
The man chooses apple pie and cream for dessert.
The woman chooses white chocolate cake for dessert.
